Hello Simen
Sry fort he delay, now I checked the chargers and for example I found that on the charger dbJ0Lc
We have a websocketPingIntervall as 0 and that has to be changed to something like 60s the heartbeat is 900 it can stay that way but you can also try and test with 240s .
Here a copy from the config file from dbJ0Lc:
"WebSocketPingInterval": {
"readonly": false,
"value": 0,
"unit": "seconds"
},
},
"HeartbeatInterval": {
"readonly": false,
"value": 900,
"unit": "seconds"
},
I found the same configuration setup
“charger-config.json” in QW8U7O
That should be done on al these chargers, the “pingpong” will avoid “offline” states.
Can you check this and give me feedback afterwards?
dbJ0Lc
Router2 Offline
5CJcFt
SCB Offline
QW8U7O
Router 1&2 Online
nzEY1R
Router 1&2 Online
fSRVQF
Router2 Offline
UQUJot
SCB Offline
Thank you.

additional_info.subject: RE: 0377880 - ID0377880-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / R1 170001223] Bad OCPP connection performance CRM:00439000681
additional_info.body:
Hello Simen
chargers 5CJcFt and UQUJot are offline in SCB you have to get them back online so we can check the connection.
Can you send us the OCPP Server logs of the Time disconnections. We want to see the errorflags which are dispayed in the Backend.
We already checkt the config on router side and they are already set correctly.
the failover, router internally called "multiwan" is actively disabled by the charger on the first startup with the router. You can see that in the logs like
Plain Text
[disableMultiWan] disable multiwan...
[routerRPC] command: uci params: ["set","multiwan.config.enabled=0"]
[routerRPC] command: uci params: ["set","multiwan.config=multiwan"]
[routerRPC] command: uci params: ["commit","multiwan"]
[Configure Router]: disble Multiwan done
Nevertheless I guess you are referring to the UI where it is stated as enabled:
Due to issues with the naming of the internal configurations we left the settings as they are but disabled the whole multiwan feature.
As it is selected on the UI unfortunately as soon as you press the "save" button, you would enable the multiwan, if you leave the UI as it is in the picture.
As long as no manual configuration has been done on the router mutliwan is disabled.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Semih

additional_info.subject: RE: 0377880 - ID0377880-DC/Si-D/NO-[MP / R1 170001223] Bad OCPP connection performance CRM:00439000681
additional_info.body:
Hi,
If the settings is correct then its okay. I asked the costumer again and apparently the 70% downtime is also outlets unavailable etc.
So we wont spent much more time on this. Settings regarding their OCPP backend its not the issue here so wont go further with that.
All OCPP settings are the same for over 80 chargers.
I think coap polling and other known issues are just as much the cause here.
You can close this ticket, its not only one root cause here.
/Simen
